title: "About"
---

## Overview

**VedicDateTime** is an R package that implements key components of the **Vedic calendar system** (lunisolar) and provides conversions from **Gregorian date-time** or **Julian Day Number** to Vedic calendar entities.

The package is presented in the paper:

> Bokde, N. D., Patil, P. K., Sengupta, S., Sawant, M., & Feijóo-Lorenzo, A. E. (2023). *VedicDateTime: An R package to implement Vedic calendar system*. Multimedia Tools and Applications. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11042-023-16553-w

## Authors (paper)

- Neeraj Dhanraj Bokde
- Prajwal Kailasnath Patil
- Saradindu Sengupta
- Manisha Sawant
- Andrés E. Feijóo-Lorenzo

## What the package includes (paper summary)

- Panchanga entities: **tithi**, **vaara**, **nakshatra**, **yoga**, **karana**
- Conversions between **Gregorian dates** and **Julian day numbers**
- Additional functions such as sunrise/sunset, moonrise/moonset, solar/lunar longitudes, and derived entities like rashi/masa/ritu/samvatsara

## Implementation notes (from the paper)

The paper describes algorithmic elements such as:

- Calculations anchored to **sunrise** for a specified location
- Use of **Lahiri Ayanamsa** (sidereal correction)
- Use of **Swiss Ephemeris** (via R dependencies) for astronomical quantities
- Determining end times using **Inverse Lagrange interpolation** with **0.25 day offsets**

## Limitations & future scope (as stated in the paper)

The paper notes planned improvements including:

- Adding **visualization capabilities** for calendar entities
- Creating native **R date-time class (S4) support** for Vedic date-time objects
